san-francisco-bay-area-big-sur-pacific-c.slogan: A 260 km loop out of Big Sur Pacific Coast Day
san-francisco-bay-area-big-sur-pacific-c.story: A proper escape from San Francisco Bay Area with roads worth waking up for. Out of Richmond and back again: 260 km, roughly 4 h 43 in the saddle. On the way it passes Scenic stretch near Orinda, near Half Moon Bay and South San Francisco. The climb of the day is in Ashland. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Big Sur Pacific Coast Day fuel gate → Big Sur Pacific Coast Day scenic
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
